title: 2026年6月四级真题 第2套 阅读1
paperTitle: 2026年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
passage:
P1 People who systematically underestimate themselves and their own performance suffer from the so-called Impostor Phenomenon. They think that any success is due to external circumstances or just luck and chance. Those people live in constant fear that their "deception" will be exposed.

P2 It is common for people to question their abilities now and again. A healthy amount of reflection and self-doubt can protect a person from acting impulsively. However, there are people who are permanently plagued by a massive amount of self-doubt despite delivering a good performance. They think that all of their successes are not a product of their skill or hard work, instead they attribute their own successes to external circumstances, for example, to luck and chance, or believe that their performance is massively overestimated by others. Failures, on the other hand, are always internalised as the result of their own shortcomings.

P3 Psychologists from Martin Luther University Halle-Wittenberg examined the topic for the first time under real-life conditions. Seventy-six participants completed a range of intelligence tests and received positive feedback on them, regardless of their actual performance. They were then asked why they think they did so well.

P4 The study showed two things: First, the self-reported degree of Impostor Phenomenon is not related to actual measured intelligence or performance. Secondly, the test supported the assumption that people with a tendency to exhibit the Impostor Phenomenon devalue their objectively measured performance and attribute positive results to external causes such as luck and chance, but not to their own abilities. These results are also completely unrelated to age and gender.

P5 A permanent underestimation of one's own abilities is often accompanied by the fear that this supposed intellectual deception will be exposed sooner or later and that they will pay the price for this. The Impostor Phenomenon was first described in 1978 by US psychologists Pauline Clance and Suzanne Imes. They observed that there is a particularly high number of successful women who do not think they are very intelligent. The Impostor Phenomenon is not defined as a mental illness. However, people who suffer from it show a higher vulnerability to depression.

questions.q: What do we learn from the passage about people who suffer from the so-called Impostor
options: They systematically underestimate their chances of success.
They tend to attribute their achievements to good fortune.
They seem to live in constant fear of being deceived.
They generally rely on luck and chance for success.
questions.explain:
【判型】What do we learn from the passage about people who suffer from the so-called Impostor Phenomenon? 是问'关于某类人我们能了解到什么'，答案应在文中找对该类人的 直接描述。 46. What do we learn from the passage about people who suffer from the so-called Impostor Phenomenon? A) They systematically underestimate their chances of success. B) They tend to attribute their achievements to good fortune. C) They seem to live in constant fear of being deceived. D) They generally rely on luck and chance for success.

【拆句】What do we learn from the passage about people who suffer from the so-called Impostor Phenomenon? 是主谓宾结构的特殊疑问句；主干为 What do we learn， about 短语限定讨论对象，who 定语从句修饰 people，整体无否定、比较等陷阱。

【定位】They think that any success is due to external circumstances or just luck and chance. 他们认为任何成功都归因于外部环境，或者仅仅是运气和机遇。

【选项】A) 偷换概念 选项说 systematically underestimate their chances of success，但原文是 systematically underestimate themselves and their own performance，低估的对 象从'自己和自身表现'被偷换为'成功几率'，语义不一致。 B) ✓ 正确 any success is due to external circumstances or just luck and chance ↔ tend to attribute their achievements to good fortune tend to attribute their achievements to good fortune 准确对应 any success is due to... luck and chance，只是把'成功归因于运气'换了说法。 C) 偷换概念 选项 live in constant fear of being deceived 利用了原文 live in constant fear 和 deception 两个词，但原文是害怕'自己的欺骗被揭穿'，不是害怕'被别人欺骗'。 D) 过度推断 选项 generally rely on luck and chance for success 说患者'依靠'运气获得成功，但原 文 any success is due to external circumstances or just luck and chance 只是说他 们'认为'成功归因于运气，并非真的去依靠运气。 拥有适度反思和自我怀疑的人往往会做什么？ A) 把所有的成功都归功于努力工作。 B) 努力使自己的技能臻于完善。 C) 避免凭冲动行事。 D) 表现得更好。

questions.q: What do people with a healthy amount of reflection and self-doubt tend to do?
options: Credit all their successes to hard work.
Strive hard to perfect their skills.
Refrain from acting on impulse.
Deliver a better performance.
questions.explain:
【判型】What do people with a healthy amount of reflection and self-doubt tend to do? 询问 具备某特征的人群 tend to do 什么，属于对文中具体行为信息的提取。

【拆句】What do people with a healthy amount of reflection and self-doubt tend to do? 中 with 短语作后置定语修饰 people，tend to do 询问习惯性结果，句子平直，无复杂从句。

【定位】A healthy amount of reflection and self-doubt can protect a person from acting impulsively. 适度的反思和自我怀疑能够防止一个人冲动行事。 47. What do people with a healthy amount of reflection and self-doubt tend to do? A) Credit all their successes to hard work. B) Strive hard to perfect their skills. C) Refrain from acting on impulse. D) Deliver a better performance.

【选项】A) 张冠李戴 选项 Credit all their successes to hard work 说健康反思者把所有成功归功于努力，但 原文 there are people who are permanently plagued by... self-doubt 之后说的是 IP 患者不把成功归因于自身 skill or hard work，并未说健康反思者就会归因于努力。 B) 无中生有 选项 Strive hard to perfect their skills 在原文关于健康反思者的描述中没有对应信息， 属于凭空添加。 C) ✓ 正确 protect a person from acting impulsively ↔Refrain from acting on impulse Refrain from acting on impulse 与 protect a person from acting impulsively 语义 等值，只是从'被保护不冲动'转换为'主动克制不冲动'。 D) 答非所问 选项 Deliver a better performance 暗示健康反思者会表现更好，但原文 despite delivering a good performance 是修饰 IP 患者的，与健康反思者无比较关系。 根据哈雷-维滕贝格马丁·路德大学心理学家的说法，遭受冒名顶替现象困扰的人常常会怎么做？ A) 把自己的成就归功于他人。 B) 否认自己经测量得出的实际智力水平。 C) 声称自己对自身能力充满信心。 D) 给客观评定的表现打低分。

questions.q: What do Impostor Phenomenon sufferers often do according to psychologists from Martin Luther
options: Attribute their accomplishments to others.
Deny their actual measured intelligence.
Claim to have confidence in their own abilities.
Mark down their objectively rated performance.
questions.explain:
【判型】What do Impostor Phenomenon sufferers often do according to psychologists from Martin Luther University Halle-Wittenberg? 问的是某研究发现中患者'经常做什么'，答 案应出自研究结论句。

【拆句】What do Impostor Phenomenon sufferers often do according to psychologists from Martin Luther University Halle-Wittenberg? 主干为 What do sufferers do，according to 引出信息来源，句子结构简单，无否定比较。

【定位】people with a tendency to exhibit the Impostor Phenomenon devalue their objectively measured performance and attribute positive results to external causes such as luck and chance, but not to their own abilities. 有表现出冒名顶替现象倾向的人会贬低他们客观测得的表现，并把积极结果归因于运气等外 部原因，而非他们自己的能力。 48. What do Impostor Phenomenon sufferers often do according to psychologists from Martin Luther University Halle-Wittenberg? A) Attribute their accomplishments to others. B) Deny their actual measured intelligence. C) Claim to have confidence in their own abilities. D) Mark down their objectively rated performance.

【选项】A) 偷换概念 选项 Attribute their accomplishments to others 说患者把成就归因于'他人'，但原文 attribute positive results to external causes such as luck and chance 说的是'运气等 外部原因'，external causes 不等于 others。 B) 偷换概念 选项 Deny their actual measured intelligence 说患者否认实际测得的智力，但原文 the self-reported degree of Impostor Phenomenon is not related to actual measured intelligence or performance 只是说两者无关，并未说患者否认智力。 C) 与原文相反 选项 Claim to have confidence in their own abilities 说患者声称对自己能力有信心， 但原文明确说患者把成功归因于外部原因 'but not to their own abilities'，说明他们并 不信任自己的能力。 D) ✓ 正确 devalue their objectively measured performance ↔ Mark down their objectively rated performance Mark down their objectively rated performance 几乎是 devalue their objectively measured performance 的同义改写，只是换了动词和形容词。 当一个人长期低估自己的能力时，会发生什么？ A) 他们会把注意力集中在外部因素上。 B) 他们会害怕可能产生的后果。 C) 他们会依靠好运取得成功。 D) 他们会不断提高自己的技能。

questions.q: What happens when a person permanently underestimates their own abilities?
options: They will focus their attention on external factors.
They will be fearful of potential consequences.
They will count on good fortune for success.
They will keep improving their own skills.
questions.explain:
【判型】What happens when a person permanently underestimates their own abilities? 询问 某种情况下会发生什么，答案在原文的条件-结果句中。

【拆句】What happens when a person permanently underestimates their own abilities? 中 when 引导时间/条件状语从句，主句省略了 happen 的实体主语，整体为简单因果结构。

【定位】A permanent underestimation of one's own abilities is often accompanied by the fear that this supposed intellectual deception will be exposed sooner or later and that they will pay the price for this. 长期低估自己的能力常常伴随着一种恐惧：这种所谓的智力欺骗迟早会被揭穿，并且他们会 为此付出代价。 49. What happens when a person permanently underestimates their own abilities? A) They will focus their attention on external factors. B) They will be fearful of potential consequences. C) They will count on good fortune for success. D) They will keep improving their own skills.

【选项】A) 答非所问 选项 focus their attention on external factors 描述的是患者对成功的外部归因，属于 第 46、48 题的内容，不是长期低估能力带来的结果。 B) ✓ 正确 the fear that this supposed intellectual deception will be exposed sooner or later and that they will pay the price for this ↔be fearful of potential consequences be fearful of potential consequences 把原文 '害怕欺骗被揭穿、害怕付出代价' 概括 为'害怕潜在后果'，符合同义概括的替换方式。 C) 过度推断 选项 count on good fortune for success 说患者'指望'好运获得成功，但原文只是说他 们认为成功归因于好运，并非真的把成功寄托于好运。 D) 无中生有 选项 keep improving their own skills 在文中没有对应信息，属于用常识捏造的积极 结果。 美国心理学家 Pauline Clance 和 Suzanne Imes 对遭受冒名顶替现象困扰的人作何评价？ A) 他们更容易患抑郁症。 B) 他们很少能够充分发挥自己的潜力。 C) 他们会患上精神疾病。 D) 他们有一天会付出更高的代价。

questions.q: What did US psychologists Pauline Clance and Suzanne Imes say about Impostor Phenomenon
options: They are more liable to have depression.
They seldom realise their potential fully.
They will develop mental illnesses.
They will pay higher prices one day.
questions.explain:
【判型】What did US psychologists Pauline Clance and Suzanne Imes say about Impostor Phenomenon sufferers? 问特定人物对患者的说法，属于对文中观点句的提取。

【拆句】What did US psychologists Pauline Clance and Suzanne Imes say about Impostor Phenomenon sufferers? 是过去时特殊疑问句，say about 后接对象，结构简单；注意 did 提示事件发生在过去。

【定位】However, people who suffer from it show a higher vulnerability to depression. 然而，患有冒名顶替现象的人表现出更高的抑郁易感性。 50. What did US psychologists Pauline Clance and Suzanne Imes say about Impostor Phenomenon sufferers? A) They are more liable to have depression. B) They seldom realise their potential fully. C) They will develop mental illnesses. D) They will pay higher prices one day.

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 people who suffer from it show a higher vulnerability to depression ↔ They are more liable to have depression They are more liable to have depression 准确对应 people who suffer from it show a higher vulnerability to depression，把'易感性高'换成'更容易患上'。 B) 过度推断 选项 They seldom realise their potential fully 说患者很少充分发挥潜力，原文只提到 他们低估自己和害怕被揭穿，没有明确说他们潜力发挥不足。 C) 与原文相反 选项 They will develop mental illnesses 说患者会发展成精神疾病，但原文 The Impostor Phenomenon is not defined as a mental illness 明确说它不是精神疾病。 D) 偷换概念 选项 They will pay higher prices one day 把原文 they will pay the price for this 中 的 the price 改成了 higher prices，添加了比较含义，改变了原意。
